generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The Bidder shall ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of KPPP on or before the last date of bid submission.

The tenderer is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of KPPP portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidder s end
EMD payments through e-payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in the part are liable for rejection.
The Tender are invited as per Standard Tender bid document KW-1
Conditional Tenders will not be considered
All relevant documents as per the KW-1 need to be uploaded while submitting bid in general documents provision in KPPP portal.
The Employer reserves the right to accept or reject any of the tender without assigning any reason.

The contractor has make his own arrangements for procurement of all the required materials and the materials so procured shall confirm to the relevant IS Specifications or Equivalent and obtain necessary quality certificate from authorized quality control.

The Contractor is fully responsible for the Equipment / Material until the same is handed over to the EXECUTIVE ENGINEER in an operating condition after commissioning. The Contractor is responsible for the proper maintenance of equipment / material as well as protection of the same against theft, elements of nature, damages etc., while in his custody as well as after erection until the same is taken over by the EXECUTIVE ENGINEER under due acknowledgment in writing
All the documents required as per technical qualification criteria needed to be uploaded in Original or Attested by any official not below the rank of Executive Engineer or Notary

The Contractors should submit all the Documents as uploaded in Original or duly attested by a Notary/an officer not below the rank of an Executive Engineer on or before opening of Technical Bid as Notified.
Name, address, and telephone, telex, and fax numbers of the contractor is to be provided .

The contractor has to furnish Additional security deposit for unbalance tender as per clause 29.1 of ITT, to an amount equal to difference in contract price and amount put to tender, in addition to 5% performance guarantee (in any of the form prescribed) while concluding the Agreement.
Unique Document Identification Number (UDIN) from Practicing Chartered Accountant is preferred in Annual Turn over

The intending bidders are advised to visit the site of work and make themselves familiar with the local situation regarding the availability of the construction materials, workmen, land required for construction activities etc.
The tenderer shall also disclose if there are any bankruptcy proceedings against him

The Contractor shall provide work program as per Clause 25 under the chapter Time control of conditions of contract. The contractor should adhere to the accepted execution plan submitted by him under any circumstances without linking to the pending payment of the work.

During the execution of the works, if any minor minerals are required, contractors have to abide by the Karnataka Minor Mineral Concession Rules 1994 (as amended up to date). As per the prevailing rules for any use of minor minerals the contractor has to submit the Mineral Dispatch Permit obtained from Mines and Geology Department. If Mineral Dispatch Permit (MDP) is not submitted by the contractor along with the bill, the prevailing penalty and DMF contribution as per Karnataka Minor Mineral Concession Rules 1994 ( as amended from time to time) will be deducted from the contractors bill at the time of payment

The Work Done Certificates shall be issued by the Executive Engineer (if work done in Karnataka State), otherwise it shall be issued/ counter signed by Superintending Engineer (if work is done in other states).
A copy of GST registration certificate should be uploaded

The contractor shall quote the rates without adding GST for either materials or works contract (Service). GST payable by the contractor under this works contract will be paid to the contractor separately over and above the contractor s bid amount. The increase if any in the GST shall not be paid in the extended period of Contract for which the Contractor alone is responsible for delay as determined by the Authority.

Estimate rates are excluding GST as per Common SR 2023-24 and prevailing GST (18 Percent of Amount put to Tender) amount is kept in form of Overhead sum in sanctioned estimate. According to guidelines in Common SR Amount put to tender and ECV amount are including GST. KPPP Portal format has No Options to add GST separately. The item wise rates do not include GST. Hence, GST will be paid separately for the quoted amount accordingly. Declaration Certificate must be attached mandatorily
If the GST rates are revised during the contract period, payment will be made/withdrawn accordingly

technicalCriterionList.description: List of works for which tenders already submitted

Mandating satisfactory completion as a prime Consultant for at least one similar work i.e. At least one Hydrology report connected to PMF probable maximum flood should have been approved from concerned Department to an extent of 50% of the cost of the work for Rs.4.70 lakhs

Liquid assets and or availability of credit facilities of not less than Rs.3.00 Lakhs (credit lines/letter of credit/certificates from banks) for meeting the fund requirement etc. (usually 30% of the amount of contract.)
Should have been registered as consultant for EAP
A Copy of GST Registration Certificate
Income Tax :Latest copy of the Income Tax Clearance Certificate and Sale Tax Clearance PAN and TAN Nos
Scanned signature of the bidder/representative to be attached while uploading the bid document
Contractor should upload their letter head with address details and contact number

To qualify for award of this contract each tenderer in his name should have in the last five years period Achieved in at least two financial years an average annual financial turnover of Rs.9.40 lakhs (usually not less than the estimated cost under this contract).

technicalCriterionList.description: Assessed available tender capacity (AxNx2.5-B) Where A-Maximum value of civil engineering works executed in any one year during the last five years (updated to 2026-27 price level) taking into account the completed as well as works in progress. Tender Inviting Authority N- Number of years prescribed for completion of the works for which Tenders are invited. B -Value, at 2026-27 price level of existing commitments and on-going works to be completed during the next 3/12 years (period of completion of the works for which Tenders are invited) Note: The statements showing the value of existing commitments and on-going works as well as the stipulated period of completion remaining for each of the works listed should be countersigned by the Employer in charge, not below the rank of an Executive Engineer or equivalent.

itemList.description: Conducting total station survey by using survey grade equipment to access the cross section area of water in the halla at HFL on the upstream and down streams of tanks having approximate length of the halla 5 km survey. Latest RTK/PPK. Enable should be used for carrying out the survey IMU sensor was calibrates to ensure the no pin- cushion or barrel errors. Geo-referenced to wgs-84 altitude reference to the FRL of the reservoir. Collection of data and processing analysis of data to get the results. HOM, labor charges, transportation of labor, duties etc., complete etc., complete with all leads & lifts, as per detailed specifications, drawings and directions of the Engineer-in-Charge. (Relevant IS Specifications)

Hydrological review of the tank including DEM processing catchment parameter extraction, development of SUH, rainfall estimation and critical sequencing of rainfall , channel routing ,flood estimation and reservoir routing . Submitting 5 sets of approved Hydrological review for Catchment area up to 1 ksqkm etc., complete with all leads & lifts, as per detailed specifications, drawings and directions of the Engineer-in-Charge. (Relevant IS Specifications)

Preparation of O&M Manual or update an existing O&M Manual for all kind of dams as per CWC guidelines , specific O&M Manual for effective operation and maintenance of all its civil and hydro mechanical components. Including General Information, Project Operation, Project Inspection, Project Maintenance Instrumentation and Monitoring with technological advancement in rehabilitation materials, surveillance and monitoring systems, comprehensive dam safety inspection and risk assessment, etc., (1)Obtaining Metrological Data for the respective Tank location from the concerned Department to carry out the flood Routing which is necessary in developing the Dam break Analysis. (2)Submitting 5 sets of approved O & M Booklets etc., complete with all leads & lifts, as per detailed specifications, drawings and directions of the Engineer-in-Charge. (Relevant IS Specifications)

Determine the potential inundated area, by defining PMF/ SPF/100 years flood/dam break food profiles downstream of the dam conditions to be considered may include-Fair weather dam failure at normal full pool levels, Design flood with and without failure, As appropriate, other flood flow conditions, with and without failure, to determine the worst case scenarios, Prepare inundation maps which clearly depict the flooded areas under conditions mentioned, Determine & identify those situations or triggering events that would initiate an emergency action, and specify the actions to be taken and by whom, Identify all jurisdictions, agencies and individuals who will be involved in the EAP. Discuss the development of the EAP with these parties, his interaction should include discussion on the need for the operation of an emergency operations center and reception center, as well as a discussion of evacuation (destinations, priorities & procedures), post flood actions (recovery & clean up), and other measures in the event of an emergency. Identify primary & auxiliary communications systems both internal (between persons at the dam) and external (between dam personnel & outside entities), List and prioritize all persons and entities involved in the notification process, and draft the Notification Flowchart, Develop a draft of the EAP. A suggested format for an EAP is described in the next chapter along with suggestions for what content might be important to be included in the EAP, Make any revisions, obtain the necessary approvals / concurrences on EAP and disseminate the EAP to those who have responsibilities under the plan. Submitting 5 sets of approved EAP etc., complete with all leads & lifts, as per detailed specifications, drawings and directions of the Engineer-in-Charge. (Relevant IS Specifications)
